Been useing the 'toss-and-wash' method for weeks (not impressed with it). Did some thinking and research and found something fun, its alcohol extraction mixed with the toss an wash.
Things needed, a glass bottle, alcohol of choice (stronger the better)
Preparation:
I put 3 grams of kratom in bottle, 1-2 grams blue lotus extract [discrepancy with Reported Dose field, which says: "6 grams kratom 1-3 grams blue lotus extract"]
Fill bottle with alcohol just to the top of of the powder
Add heat (microwave stove top etc) letting it boil for about 3 min
Take it off and find a nice hot spot in the house (like a garage) let it sit for about a week
When its ready to be consumed, I take a 1-3 grams toss and wash style, and then drink. Very similar to the tea method as far as effects but way less is needed, in the opinion of the author it is equivalent to 10 grams using the tea method.
Now as far as effects felt, it was very relaxing and or calming, with the heightened effect from the blue lotus extract, felt much like falling in space, falling upwards how ever that feeling is best described, and yet energetically charged.
